title: Raise the follow-on round
summary: Cap table audited, data room fresh, the priced round closed, SAFEs converted, the 409A refreshed.

parts.title: Audit cap table
parts.guidance: Reconcile ownership and financing records before presenting the company to follow-on investors. Compare the cap table with signed issuance, transfer, option and convertible-instrument documents, investigating unexplained balances. Return an audit trail and unresolved discrepancies to the financing team so negotiations use an explicit, supportable starting position.

parts.title: Set up a data room
parts.guidance: Refresh the financing data room with the corporate, financial, commercial and ownership records investors need to assess the round. Replace superseded versions, identify missing documents and restrict sensitive material to the intended recipients. Give the financing team an indexed room whose documents and open requests can be traced to their owners.

parts.title: Close a priced equity round
parts.guidance: Run the priced-round workflow against the negotiated economics, current ownership records and counsel-reviewed transaction documents. Track corporate approvals, investor signatures, closing conditions and confirmed funds separately. Preserve the actual closing record so SAFE conversions and the updated cap table follow the transaction that closed, including any deviations from the initial proposal.

parts.title: Convert SAFEs at the priced round
parts.guidance: Gather each outstanding SAFE and its amendments alongside the proposed round documents. Use the conversion workflow to model treatment under those exact instruments and review the pro-forma ownership before closing. Obtain counsel and corporate approval for the resulting actions, then reconcile completed conversions to the final closing records, showing the assumptions and instrument-specific exceptions used in each calculation.

parts.title: Get a 409A valuation
parts.guidance: Review whether the completed financing or other material developments require an updated common-stock valuation before the next intended option grants. Supply the valuation workflow with the actual round terms, financial information and ownership records. Have the reviewer assess the common-stock value in light of the financing terms, then document the report and its intended use for the proposed grants.

parts.title: Update cap table
parts.guidance: Update the cap table from the completed round, reviewed conversions and other authorized equity changes. Tie each entry to executed documents and relevant payment or issuance evidence. Reconcile the final ownership totals and preserve the approved post-close version so the next financing, grant or investor report starts from the same supportable record.
